mapper.select:
SELECT DATE(t.done_at) AS statsDay, COUNT(1) AS doneCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.due_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS doneWithDueCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.done_at <= t.due_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onTimeCount FROM workspace_task t WHERE t.org_id = #{orgId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'DONE' AND t.done_at >= #{from} AND t.done_at < #{to}
GROUP BY DATE(t.done_at) ORDER BY statsDay ASC

SELECT t.task_type AS taskType, COUNT(1) AS doneCount FROM workspace_task t WHERE t.org_id = #{orgId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'DONE' AND t.done_at >= #{from} AND t.done_at < #{to}
GROUP BY t.task_type ORDER BY doneCount DESC, t.task_type ASC

SELECT t.assignee_staff_id AS staffId, MAX(sp.display_name) AS staffName, 0 AS doneCount, 0 AS doneWithDueCount, 0 AS onTimeCount, COUNT(1) AS overdueOpenCount, 0 AS followupDoneCount FROM workspace_task t LEFT JOIN staff_profile sp ON sp.id = t.assignee_staff_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.org_id = #{orgId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'OPEN' AND t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.due_at < #{now} AND t.assignee_staff_id IS NOT NULL
AND t.assignee_staff_id IN ()
GROUP BY t.assignee_staff_id

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM workspace_task t WHERE t.org_id = #{orgId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'OPEN' AND t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.due_at < #{now} AND t.assignee_staff_id IS NULL
AND 1 = 0

SELECT f.completed_by_staff_id AS staffId, MAX(sp.display_name) AS staffName, 0 AS doneCount, 0 AS doneWithDueCount, 0 AS onTimeCount, 0 AS overdueOpenCount, COUNT(1) AS followupDoneCount FROM followup_record f LEFT JOIN staff_profile sp ON sp.id = f.completed_by_staff_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE f.org_id = #{orgId} AND f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.status = 'DONE' AND f.completed_at >= #{from} AND f.completed_at < #{to} AND f.completed_by_staff_id IS NOT NULL
AND f.completed_by_staff_id IN ( SELECT ctm.staff_id FROM care_team_member ctm WHERE ctm.team_id = #{careTeamId} AND ctm.member_type = 'STAFF' AND ctm.is_deleted = 0 AND ctm.staff_id IS NOT NULL )
GROUP BY f.completed_by_staff_id
SELECT ctm.staff_id FROM care_team_member ctm WHERE ctm.team_id = #{careTeamId} AND ctm.member_type = 'STAFF' AND ctm.is_deleted = 0 AND ctm.staff_id IS NOT NULL
